correctness.rationale: Lucas for m=p^e gives binomial(ma+r,j)=binomial(r,j) mod p for j<m. Hence Hasse osculating incidence coordinate x_{ma+r}=z^a w_r, z=t^m. Every 2x2 scroll minor vanishes, and conversely on dense chart z,w the triangular equations in lambda_j invert after choosing an m-th root t, proving equality of reduced image with smooth balanced scroll S(floor((d-r)/m)). Standard scroll ideal prime, dimension m degree d-m+1, for d>=2m-1 all directrices positive. Function-field extension k(t,w)/k(t^m,w) is purely inseparable of degree m, as z is not p-th power, and Frobenius ruling pullback has contact length m. The theorem does not cover special incidence fibers or low-degree cone boundary.
